name: Left-side Trouble
source:
Hinomiya Saki is an ordinary high school girl and still don't have any friends. Until a 'ghost' suddenly appears on her left seat and keeps bothering her.

[From [url=https://taralost1.itch.io/left-side-trouble]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
日宫咲是一名普通的女高中生，至今还没有朋友。直到一个“鬼”突然出现在她的左边座位上，一直困扰着她。

[来自[url=https://taralost1.itch.io/left-side-trouble]Itch.io[/url]]
